summary: Built in the 1940s as a tourist tower at Water Gap, moved to Duncannon in 1999; the Old Sled Works where it stands is permanently closed.

facts.status_note: Moved in 1999 to the Old Sled Works lot in Duncannon; that business says it is permanently closed

access.note: Tours ran through the Old Sled Works, which says it is permanently closed; no source says whether the tower can be climbed now

visit.trail_note: The Appalachian Trail is two blocks away

events.note: Sources say only 'the 1940s'; 1940 is the record's year, not a documented date

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Wikidata classes it as a fire lookout tower; WillhiteWeb, the 2014 travel blog and French Wikipedia describe a tourist observation tower built beside a restaurant. The name follows the Wikidata label.

notes_for_editor: The brief's 1940 built year is more precise than the sources (they say the 1940s). The 1999 move date rests only on the French Wikipedia infobox; a Facebook post also gives 1999 but was not read or cited. Wikidata calls it a fire lookout tower, which conflicts with the travel and hiking pages. The Old Sled Works closure notice is undated and says nothing about the tower's condition. Brief coordinates were not checked.
